item.title: An unexpected hero prevents a potential major forest fire in Surf City
item.description: An unexpected hero prevented a potential major forest fire in the Surf City area early this morning, March 3, 2026.

item.title: Rouzer wins Republican nomination for US House in NC’s 7th Congressional District
item.description: Incumbent U.S. Rep. David Rouzer has secured the Republican nomination for North Carolina’s 7th Congressional District.

item.title: Wilmington Police Department investigates shooting in 1100 block of S. 7th Street
item.description: The Wilmington Police Department is actively investigating a shooting from the 1100 block of S. 7th Street, near Marstellar St. Officers responded to a shot spotter alert just before 8:30 p.m.

item.title: Lucky 7: Civelli the hero in Laney’s 3-2 comeback win over South Brunswick
item.description: Coming off a trip to the state championship last season, Laney baseball took their home opener 3-2 over South Brunswick on Tuesday.

item.title: Brian Chism unofficially wins Republican primary for Brunswick County sheriff
item.description: Brian Chism is the unofficial winner of the Republican primary for Brunswick County sheriff, according to preliminary election results Tuesday night.

item.title: UNCW plates seven in 3rd in 8-0 win over Coastal Carolina
item.description: They only played six innings on Tuesday, but one one of them truly mattered as UNCW softball shutout Coastal Carolina 8-0.

item.title: Bill Rogers unofficially wins Republican primary for Columbus County sheriff
item.description: Columbus County Sheriff Bill Rogers is the unofficial winner of the Republican primary for sheriff.

item.title: JK Somers unofficially wins Republican primary for district attorney
item.description: JK Somers is the unofficial winner of the Republican primary for district attorney serving Brunswick, Bladen and Columbus counties, according to preliminary election results Tuesday night.

item.title: Primary results set Nov. face off for NHCO commissioner and BOE seats
item.description: Results from the New Hanover County Democratic primary for county commissioner have come in.

item.title: Randy Burton and Elizabeth Craver lose, Jimmy Tate and Andy Devane win in surprising Pender County results
item.description: Current Board of Commissioners Chairman Randy Burton and current County Clerk of Court Elizabeth Craver lost in their bids for re-election.
